items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a short `if not ...is_cached(rel_obj):` guard placed right under the existing 'manage the reverse relation manually' comments. It matches the surrounding style and needs no extra explanation.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing FieldCacheMixin.is_cached API with no new bookkeeping. The same guard appears in three descriptors, which keeps them consistent rather than counting as copy-paste. Scratch files were removed and the added regression test is clean.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The guards change no error handling and only skip overwriting an existing cache entry. Uncached children still get the parent assigned. The full prefetch_related suite and the hidden tests pass (P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): setattr(...)`, and ReverseOneToOneDescriptor gets `if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`. The added test covers both the one-to-one and FK variants, and plain prefetches still populate the reverse relation.
